text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Fenomeno! Winning against a 
lineup like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(This was a wonderful battle! A true race! 
Both of us giving our all——)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――!? Bloodlust!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ! Gentile-san!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Let us drink the bitter cup we have been 
given down to the last drop.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...There will not be a next time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A truly formidable person, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Though she may be far too intense to 
be called a role model.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, her posture possesses a strength 
that makes you want to look up to her.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I must learn from this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Gentildonna-san right now... Golshi-san 
up until now... For my own growth, they're 
both—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Gold Ship! Do you even know why you 
lost?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If you'd just trained seriously, you might 
have won! What were you thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Seaweed dance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: G-GOOOLSHIII-SAAAN!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san, please make your way to the 
Winner's Circle!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...Y-Yes! Right away!"

text_block_list.name: @Hardcore_Stan_564
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi, you lost this time, but I'll 
still be rooting for you next time. Don't 
let it get you down!"

""@Hardcore564Stan Fenomeno working hard 
at practice is true justice. Slacking 
Golshi is evil.""

text_block_list.name: @Nununu
text_block_list.text:
"There's something about Gold Ship that 
makes you want to follow her. I wonder 
what GⅠ race she's running in next?"

""@nununu Fenomeno working hard at 
practice is true justice. Slacking Golshi 
is evil.""

text_block_list.name: @Nameless_Lucifer
text_block_list.text: "Uh-oh, some weird fans are popping up."

text_block_list.name: @Car♪rot♪
text_block_list.text:
""@AnonymousLucifer Aren't they just 
speaking the truth?""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened the day after the Takarazuka 
Kinen, on the way back from our away race.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: S-Shut up--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —!? What is the meaning of this—

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Why would you say it like that!? Cut 
it out, that's just mean!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's just total common sense! 
Ev-ery-one is saying it!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's a villain! A bad guy! You're 
weird for liking someone like that!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
"N-No! You're wrong! Even Golshi would—... 
U-Uwaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text: H-Hold up, violence is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
HALT RIGHT THEEEERE!! Stop right where you 
are, all of youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I am Officer Fenomeno of Tracen Academy. 
...May I ask about the situation, sir?"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fenomeno! Help! This guy was about to 
punch me!!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: Because... ...Because—!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"Because Golshi is weird! Anyone who likes 
Golshi is weird too!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: No! Golshi is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...This officer will take charge of this 
matter. You with the black hat, come with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...*hic*, *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sit the child in the black hat on a 
bench and gently stroke their back until 
they calm down.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
They told everyone that Golshi's a bad 
person. So that's why I...

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: It's so frustrating... so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Is it weird that I like Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: Is it bad that I like Gold Ship...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If Golshi-san is who you look up to, you 
can stay just as you are. You're good to 
go, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She may not be a role model... but she 
isn't some evil that people should be 
forbidden from admiring.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Do you like Gold Ship-san?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I see, me too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to what justice truly 
means, I still haven't found a definitive 
answer."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, justice is never meant to make 
someone cry, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...It is not a weapon to be brandished 
for the sake of hurting others."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I can't let things stay like this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Things must not remain this way...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What cruel irony...!! Even though I'm 
treated as an ally of justice, I haven't 
been able to protect a single thing...!
choice_data_list:
Blaming yourself too much is a bad habit 
of yours.

Beating yourself up too much is a bad 
habit of yours, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh.
choice_data_list: Then let's discuss what to do next.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――Hah!! There is definitely something I 
must convey.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —There are people I must tell this to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. Please, let me enter the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
On the year-end stage that captivates 
everyone, I want to convey these feelings!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach them through my 
running...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh. Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"By then, I will definitely find my own 
'justice' as well."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not just treated as a slot called "ally of 
justice." With one's own justice held 
firmly in one's heart—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I will stand as an “ally of justice”.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fenomeno and I set our next goal 
on the Arima Kinen.
